meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, excluding RRBs, from March 2023
meta.coverage: Bank offices by the size of their deposits or credit, by bank group and population group (statements 6A and 6B), every quarter since March 2023, excluding regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1421 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Private sector banks, Metropolitan, offices ranked by deposit, size class 10.00-20.00 (₹ crore, as printed), their credit on 2026-03-01).
